anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: Reboiler temperature drops sharply from ~308 °C to 298 then 281 °C over two events after being stable for 18 minutes
Condenser/overhead T705 rises from ~88 to ~96 °C concurrently
Differential pressure spikes to 3.36 mbar then 2.52, above the ~2 mbar baseline
Column temps T702/T704/T706/T708 all begin falling together, indicating loss of boilup

args.missing_evidence: Reboiler heater duty/power setpoint and level (LS701) trend, plus overhead composition sample, to distinguish loss of heating from a charge/level or flooding event
